sections.content:
In Hungary, **Névnap** (Name Day) is celebrated with almost as much importance as a birthday! Every calendar day is associated with one or more traditional Hungarian given names:
- **Boldog névnapot kívánok!** = I wish you a Happy Name Day!
- Flowers (*virág*) are traditionally brought for women, and wine/spirits or chocolates for men.
- **Felköszönt**: to toast or give celebratory greetings to someone (*Felköszöntjük Pétert a névnapján.*)

sections.title: Celebratory Greetings
rows: I wish you a Happy Name Day!
I wish you a Happy Birthday!
May God grant you long life! (traditional)

items.spanish: Ma van Katalin névnapja, virágot viszünk neki.
items.english: Today is Katalin's name day, we are bringing her flowers.
May God grant you a long life on the occasion of your birthday!
